Non-dilutive funding extends runway and supports a key Phase 2 program with registrational potential.
Backs a potentially registrational study, raising odds of expedited path if data are positive.
Allogeneic approach could broaden access and improve margins if successful.
Clear efficacy bar; upcoming readouts around Week 26 could be catalysts.
